title: CPTS arsenal
intro: A command-first pentest reference, organised by where you are in an engagement. Run your scans as usual, then come here for the next tool: pre-compromise recon and attacks up to a foothold, the privilege escalation that follows, and the miscellaneous plumbing that ties it together. Search by port, service or tool, and each tile is tagged with the target OS it applies to. Every entry is a working reference, not an exploit kit: use it only against systems you are authorised to test.

stages.name: Pre Compromise
stages.blurb: From an in-scope network to a user-level foothold: discover and enumerate the services, attack the ones that face you, enumerate the domain, and turn a web app, a weak login or captured authentication into your first shell or credential.

stages.name: Post Compromise Elevation
stages.blurb: Once you are on a box: enumerate the host, escalate to SYSTEM or root, dump the local and domain credential stores, abuse AD rights and delegation, and reuse what you find to move and climb towards full control.

stages.name: Miscellaneous
stages.blurb: The cross-cutting plumbing of an engagement: catch and stabilise shells, move files on and off a host, generate payloads, tunnel through a foothold, build wordlists and crack the hashes you capture offline.
